> **Note — Pull Requests Are Not Accepted**
>
> `pikbay` is a personal self-hosted project shared as-is and **does not accept external pull requests** (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md)).
>
> - If you found a reproducible bug, please open a [Bug Report Issue](../../issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) instead so it can be investigated directly.
> - If you want to customize `pikbay` for your own needs, please feel free to maintain a fork in accordance with the `AGPL-3.0-only` license.
